title: SharedMemberStatusChangeResponse
description: Per-member outcomes plus the recomputed shared status.

successful.description: Members whose status change was applied.

failed.description: Members whose status change was refused.

sharedStatus.description: The group's derived status after the recompute.

GatedRuleItem.description: A PSV rule result: its key, the PSV type it belongs to and a description

psvType.description: PSV type the rule belongs to, '-' when unknown

description.description: Human readable description of the rule result

coverKey.description: Stable key of the open blocker, used to match covers and acknowledgements

hiddenFromPacket.description: True when the analyst chose to hide this rule from the PSV packet (CP-40893)

NextCredentialingDateChangeLogEntry.description: Change log entry tracking changes to the next credentialing date

changedFrom.description: Previous next credentialing date in YYYY-MM-DD format

changedTo.description: New next credentialing date in YYYY-MM-DD format

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the change was made

StatusChangeResult.description: Result of a single workflow status change

errorMessage.description: Error message if the operation failed

errorCode.description: Error code if the operation failed

blockers.description: CP-42729: the open PSV blockers when the PSV progression gate refused the move; absent otherwise

TimelineEventData.description: Timeline event data containing event details. Field requirements vary by event name (see oneOf conditions in schema).

name.description: Name of the timeline event. Must be one of the TimelineStatus enum values.

changeReason.description: Reason for the change or status update. REQUIRED for: DATA_MISSING, WITHDRAWN_CANCELLED. Optional for: CRED_APPROVED, CRED_DENIED, and other statuses. Note: Whether this field is required or optional varies based on the permissions assigned to the user performing the action.

credentialingDecisionDate.description: Date when the credentialing decision was made (YYYY-MM-DD format). REQUIRED for: CRED_APPROVED, CRED_DENIED. Not applicable for other statuses.

nextCredentialingDate.description: Date when the next credentialing is due (YYYY-MM-DD format). REQUIRED for: CRED_APPROVED. Not applicable for other statuses. Should reflect the latest value from nextCredentialingDateChangeLog if present.

nextCredentialingDateSource.description: Indicates whether the next credentialing date was calculated by the system or entered by a user. Only applicable for CRED_APPROVED events.

nextCredentialingDateChangeLog.description: Array to track changes to the next credentialing date. The nextCredentialingDate field should reflect the latest value from this array. Only applicable for CRED_APPROVED events.

psvPdfPath.description: URI reference to the PSV (Provider Summary Verification) PDF document.

overrideReason.description: Indicates the reason for the override

isOverride.description: Indicates if the timeline event is an override bypassing the default validations

id.description: Unique identifier for the timeline event

workflowId.description: ID of the associated credentialing workflow

data.description: Timeline event data containing name, changeReason, and date fields

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the timeline event

updatedBy.description: ID of the user who last updated the timeline event

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the timeline event was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the timeline event was last updated
